flags.description: The list of feature flags belonging to the specified application.

id.description: The unique identifier of the feature flag.

name.description: The unique name of the feature flag within the application.

description.description: A human-readable description of the feature flag's purpose.

flagType.description: The value type of the flag. One of Boolean, String, or Number.

variants.description: The valid variant values for String or Number flags. Empty for Boolean flags.

resourceId.description: The unique identifier of the application that owns this feature flag.

labels.description: Labels attached to this feature flag for organizational or filtering purposes.

isPermanent.description: When true, the flag is marked permanent and excluded from stale flag cleanup.

cascUrl.description: The CasC (Configuration as Code) URL for this feature flag.

created.description: The date and time at which the feature flag was created.

configStates.description: The enabled or disabled state of this flag per environment. Populated only when environment IDs are requested.

updated.description: The date and time at which the feature flag was last updated.

environmentId.description: The unique identifier of the environment this state applies to.

enabled.description: Whether the feature flag is enabled in this environment.

updated.description: The date and time at which this configuration state was last updated.
